title: Ukraine hits two oil refineries deep in Russian territory
facts: Ukrainian forces conducted long-range strikes against two oil refineries located inside Russian territory.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky confirmed strikes targeting the Bashneft-Novoil and Slavneft-Yanos oil refineries.
Yaroslavl regional governor Mikhail Evraev confirmed a fire at the Slavneft-Yanos refinery following a drone attack.
The drone attack on the Slavneft-Yanos refinery injured four people.
The Bashneft-Novoil refinery in Russia's Bashkortostan republic is situated roughly 1,300 kilometers from the Ukrainian border.
The Slavneft-Yanos refinery in Yaroslavl is located approximately 700 kilometers from the Ukrainian border.
Volodymyr Zelensky stated that Ukrainian forces struck two Russian military patrol boats in the Black Sea.
Ukrainian forces targeted Russian shadow fleet vessels operating in the Black Sea.
Governor Mikhail Evraev reported that air defense forces intercepted 93 drones over the Yaroslavl region.
An overnight Russian drone strike in Balakliya, Kharkiv region, killed three people.
Kharkiv regional governor Oleh Synehubov reported two deaths from a drone strike on a train station in Lozova.
Russian military strikes killed five people in Ukraine's central Dnipropetrovsk region.
A Russian strike on critical infrastructure caused a complete power blackout in the city of Kherson.
Internet monitor NetBlocks observed regional internet connectivity in Kherson drop to 31%.
The Russian Defense Ministry claimed its forces downed 605 Ukrainian drones overnight across multiple regions.
